insidePages: {n} worksheets: one for every block. Where a worksheet has them, there is also a page for early finishers and an easier page for children who need one
pdfIntro: Everything in this pack is review, so there is nothing new to teach. Each block has one worksheet for everyone and a short script on the next pages. The blocks do not fill the whole day: between them, follow our schedule (recess, lunch, specials) and use the extra-time list. The class information sheets at the back tell you how our day runs.
pdfBefore2: Find the copied worksheets and put them in stacks in the order of the list below. Each block has a stack for everyone; many blocks also have a few copies of an easier page and a stack for early finishers. If the copies have not been made, ask the office for help before the children arrive.
pdfAny2: A child who finishes early gets the page for early finishers, if the block has one. After that the child may read a book or draw on the back of the page. If most of the class is done before the block ends, collect the pages and go to the extra-time list on the class information sheets.
pdfMorningSay: "Good morning. My name is ___. Your teacher is out today, so I am your teacher for the day. Your first job is on your desk."
pdfBell: Stop at least ten minutes before dismissal. Collect the pages, have the children clean up around their desks and pack their backpacks, and follow the dismissal list on the class information sheets. Make sure every child leaves the way the list says. If you are not sure how a child goes home or who may pick the child up, call the office; do not guess.
pdfClassSchedule: Our day: times of arrival, snack, recess, lunch, specials, and dismissal, and where the class goes for each
pdfClassRoutines: Routines: attention signal, restroom, drinks, lining up; where pencils, crayons, and counters are kept
